'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Eastern Ukraine offensive]]
****[[Battle of Kharkiv (2022)|Battle of Kharkiv]]
*****Seven people are killed by Russian shelling in downtown [[Kharkiv]], according to local authorities. [https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/3493004-death-toll-in-russias-shelling-of-kharkiv-rises-to-seven.html (Ukrinform)]
****The [[Russian defense ministry]] says that civil vessels are allowed to use a maritime humanitarian corridor to access the [[port of Mariupol]], which [[Russia]] [[Siege of Mariupol|captured last week]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-says-civil-vessels-may-use-mariupol-port-mine-danger-lifted-2022-05-26/ (Reuters)]
*[[Kivu conflict]]
**Heavy fighting between [[DRC forces]] and the [[M23 movement]] continues in [[North Kivu]] province, [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/heavy-fighting-congo-tries-fend-off-resurgent-m23-rebels-2022-05-26/ (Reuters)]
*[[Yemeni Civil War (2014–present)|Yemeni Civil War]]
**Five people are killed and more than 50 others are injured after an [[explosive device]] [[detonate]]s at a [[fish market]] in [[Aden]], [[Yemen]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/blast-yemen-fish-market-kills-least-4-people-wounds-over-30-2022-05-26/ (Reuters)]
*The [[caliph]] of the [[Islamic State]] [[Abu al-Hasan al-Hashimi al-Qurashi]] is arrested in [[Istanbul]], [[Turkey]]. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2022-05-26/turkey-has-detained-islamic-state-s-new-leader-officials-say (Bloomberg)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*''[[Tomb of Sand]]'' by [[Geetanjali Shree]] wins the 2022 [[International Booker Prize]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-61561452 (BBC News)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Lebanese liquidity crisis]]
**The value of the [[Lebanese pound]] falls to 35,600 pounds against the [[United States dollar|U.S. dollar]], its lowest value ever. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/5/26/lebanese-pound-value-drops-to-lowest-level (Al Jazeera)]
*The US seizes a [[Russia]]n owned [[oil tanker]] carrying Iranian [[crude oil]] in [[Greece]] and has transferred the cargo to another ship destined for the US. It is unclear if the seizure was due to [[United States sanctions against Iran|US sanctions against Iran]] or [[Government and intergovernmental reactions to the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine|US sanctions on Russia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/us-seizes-iranian-oil-cargo-near-greek-island-sources-2022-05-26/ (Reuters)]
*Italian [[fossil fuel]] company [[Eni]] signs an agreement with [[Algeria]]n [[state-owned enterprise|state-owned]] company [[Sonatrach]] to both [[Hydrocarbon exploration|explore]] up to 3 billion cubic meters of gas and launch a pilot [[green hydrogen]] project in the Algerian desert. The agreement comes as [[Italy]] looks to decrease its dependence on Russian gas in light of the conflict in Ukraine. [https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2022/5/26/italys-power-giant-eni-inks-deal-to-boost-algerian-gas-imports (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Chancellor of the Exchequer|British Chancellor]] [[Rishi Sunak]] announces a 25% levy, a so-called [[Windfall Tax (United Kingdom)|windfall tax]], on the profits of energy companies in order to help fund emergency economic support amid a [[cost of living]] crisis in the UK. The extra support includes increased [[welfare]] payments for low-income households, [[Disability|disabled people]] and [[pensioner]]s, as well as a universal grant of [[Pound sterling|£]]400 towards energy bills. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-61583651 (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Eleven babies are killed in a hospital fire in [[Tivaouane]], [[Senegal]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/mothers-confront-horror-after-11-babies-die-senegal-hospital-fire-2022-05-26/ (Reuters)]
*A [[cargo ship]] travelling on its way to [[Pangkajene and Islands Regency]] from [[Makassar]] sinks off the [[Makassar Strait]] in [[South Sulawesi]], [[Indonesia]]. 25 people are missing. [https://apnews.com/article/politics-indonesia-10b7cf439176ec9f5a3a75d3562bc915 (AP)]
*Two people are killed in an explosion at a [[biodiesel]] plant in [[La Rioja]], [[Spain]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/blast-spanish-biodiesel-plant-kills-two-2022-05-26/ (Reuters)]
*Five people, including four children, are killed and two more are injured in an explosion at a house in [[Pottstown, Pennsylvania]], United States. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/nation/2022/05/27/pennsylvania-house-explosion/ (''The Washington Post'')] [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/pottstown-pennsylvania-explosion-deaths-injuries/ (CBS News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2022 monkeypox outbreak]]
**[[Quebec]] will begin offering the [[smallpox vaccine#MVA-BN|Imvamune]] [[vaccine]] after 25 cases of [[monkeypox]] were confirmed in [[Provinces and territories of Canada|the province]]. [https://montrealgazette.com/news/local-news/quebec-confirms-25-cases-of-monkeypox-will-begin-offering-smallpox-vaccine (''Montreal Gazette'')]
**The [[UK Health Security Agency]] says that it has procured 20,000 doses of a [[smallpox vaccine]] produced by [[Bavarian Nordic]] as part of an effort to combat the increase in monkeypox cases. [https://www.reuters.com/world/uk/britains-ukhsa-says-it-has-procured-20000-doses-vaccine-against-monkeypox-2022-05-26/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Iraq–Israel relations]]
**The [[Council of Representatives of Iraq|Iraqi parliament]] prohibits all attempts at normalizing relations with [[Israel]] with the punishment of [[life imprisonment]] or [[capital punishment]]. The law was introduced by [[Shia]] cleric [[Muqtada al-Sadr]], [[Sadrist Movement|whose party]] won the most seats in the [[2021 Iraqi parliamentary election|last election]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/iraq-makes-it-illegal-attempt-normalising-ties-with-israel-2022-05-26/ (Reuters)] [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/iraqi-lawmakers-pass-bill-criminalizing-any-ties-with-israel-1.5919845 (CTV News)]
*[[Australia–United States relations]]
**The [[United States Department of State]] approves the sale of the [[M142 HIMARS]] multiple [[rocket launcher]] system to [[Australia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us-oks-potential-sale-himars-launchers-australia-pentagon-says-2022-05-26/ (Reuters)]
'''Law and crime'''
*[[Polish constitutional crisis]]
**The [[Parliament of Poland|Polish Parliament]] passes a law replacing the Disciplinary Chamber of the Supreme Court, established by [[Polish Supreme Court Disciplinary Chamber law|a controversial judicial reform bill]], with a new body, in order to allow the [[European Union]] to unfreeze [[Euro|€]]35 billion in COVID-19 recovery funds earmarked to [[Poland|the country]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/polish-parliament-approves-judicial-reforms-unblock-eu-funds-2022-05-26/ (Reuters)]
*[[Zimbabwe]]an courts rule that the [[Ages of consent in Africa#Zimbabwe|age of consent in Zimbabwe]] must be raised to 18. [https://apnews.com/article/politics-health-zimbabwe-africa-marriage-08726e51ab31fd3096c7b952a6f04036 (AP)]

'''Sports'''
*[[Canada–Iran relations]]
**[[Canada Soccer]] cancels a match between the [[Canada men's national soccer team|Canadian]] and [[Iran national football team|Iranian]] teams due to the latter's connection with the [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps]], which shot down  [[Ukraine International Airlines Flight 752]] in 2020. [https://www.sportsnet.ca/soccer/article/canada-soccer-cancels-mens-national-team-friendly-vs-iran-in-vancouver/ (Sportsnet)]
